plain_english_description: Peak wave period of the offshore forcing
why_it_matters: Controls the dominant forcing time scale.
Primary forcing sequence used by the sequence models.

plain_english_description: Amplitude envelope of the offshore signal
why_it_matters: Captures slow modulation and wave-group structure.

plain_english_description: Time derivative of the offshore signal
why_it_matters: Helps the network see slope and phase changes.

plain_english_description: Water depth at the local prediction station
why_it_matters: A main control on propagation, shoaling, and nearshore transformation.

plain_english_description: Cross-shore distance from offshore input to local station
why_it_matters: Proxy for propagation distance and travel path length.

plain_english_description: Local bathymetric slope at the station
why_it_matters: Captures local geometric steepness that may affect wave transformation.

plain_english_description: Path-integrated travel-time proxy from offshore to target
Linear-wave-inspired amplitude-gain proxy along the path
why_it_matters: First-order estimate of amplitude change due to shoaling.

plain_english_description: Offshore signal shifted by the travel-time proxy
why_it_matters: Provides a physically aligned arrival pattern to the model.
Provides the physics-informed first guess before residual correction.

plain_english_description: Fraction of timesteps for which the local station remains dynamically wet
why_it_matters: Low values indicate more difficult or less reliable local targets.

plain_english_description: Standard deviation of the local target sequence
why_it_matters: Higher values generally correspond to more energetic local response.
